'''2010 Worlds Day 2 James Barnes LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[James Barnes]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused]]
* '''Username:''' jcb213
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
